name: STM32MP257F-DK
description: ST's Discovery kit for the STM32MP25 series: a dual Cortex-A35 MPU with a Cortex-M33 real-time core, a Vivante GC8000UL 3D GPU and a 1.35 TOPS NPU. Runs LVGL's 2D and 3D/glTF rendering on Wayland or DRM.
shortDescription: STMicroelectronics MP2 processor devkit with 3D GPU and NPU
getStartedInstructions:
1. Open the project folder and update the submodules: `git submodule update --init --recursive` 
2. Follow the guide in the [README](https://github.com/lvgl/lv_port_linux/tree/master/boards/stm32mp257f-dk/README.md)
